name: Not Currently Available
description: Not Currently Available

name: 40mm Grenade Round
description: Low-velocity 40x46mm grenade rounds, used in conjunction with hand-held grenade launchers.

name: Magnum Ammo
description: Large-bore cartridges originally designed for revolvers, but usable in all .44 caliber firearms.

name: 9mm Pistol Ammo
description: 9x19mm Parabellum cartridges, commonly used in military handguns.

name: Eggs
description: Eggs to load into the Egglauncher. Careful, the Easter Bunny will want them back.

name: Half-Brick
description: The common half-brick, a rioters best friend. Damage increases over distance travelled, so launch at distance for the best effect.

name: Concussion Grenade
description: Concussion grenades cause extreme destruction within a small blast radius.

name: EMP Grenade
description: EMP Grenades disrupt and disable Vehicles, disabling their engine and certain modifications.

name: Eight-Ball
description: A standard eight-ball, perfect shape for a good throw. Damage increases over distance travelled, so launch at distance for the best effect.

name: Frag Grenade
description: Fragmentation grenades cause injury and collateral damage dispersed over a wide area.

name: Light Fragmentation Grenade
description: Light Fragmentation Grenades pack a lighter explosive to allow the user to carry more and throw further.

name: Percussion Grenade
description: Unlike other grenade types, percussion grenades explode on contact. They have a modest blast radius.

name: Stun Grenade
description: Stun grenades are primarily used to stun and incapacitate their targets, though they can also lightly wound.

name: 40mm LTL Grenade Round
description: 40mm crowd-dispersal grenade rounds, for use in less than lethal, hand-held grenade launchers.

name: Less Than Lethal Ammo
description: Less than lethal ammunition used in special purpose riot control firearms.

name: Less Than Lethal Pistol Ammo
description: Less than lethal rounds for special purpose personal sidearms.

name: Machine Gun Ammo
description: Specialized ammunition for use with automatic machine guns.

name: Rifle Ammo
description: Standard NATO rounds used in a variety of rifles.

name: Rocket Ammo
description: High Explosive Anti-Armor rockets, for use in shoulder-launched multi-purpose assault weapons.

name: Micro-Rocket Ammo
description: High Explosive Anti-Armor micro-rockets. These are for use with multiple projectile launchers.

name: Shotgun Ammo
description: 12 gauge buck shells, for use in shotguns.

name: High-velocity Rifle Ammo
description: High performance ammunition for use with high-velocity rifles.

name: Snowballs
description: Snowballs to throw at your enemies or load into the HoHoHoPGL. Careful, these will melt after Christmas.
